steps.name: подготовка
steps.js: window.__until = (fn, ms) => new Promise(r => { const t = setInterval(() => { if (fn()) { clearInterval(t); r(true); } }, 15); setTimeout(() => { clearInterval(t); r(false); }, ms || 15000); }); document.querySelector('.title .btn').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); FB.ui.closeAll(); const S = FB.S; S.tut = 99; S.tips = { chip: 1, profile: 1, bait: 1, bubbles: 1, drift: 1, pl_ducks: 1, see_ducks: 1, pl_current: 1 }; S.stats.catches = 30; S.luck = 4; S.xp = 3000; S.level = FB.state.levelFromXp(3000); S.rods.push('carbon'); S.rod = 'carbon'; FB.panels.goTo('river'); FB.ui.closeAll(); FB.scene.setPlace('river', 'sun'); FB.hud.update(); window.__fight = (fish, g) => { const F = FB.fishing; F.reset(); F.res = { kind: 'fish', fish: FB.fishById[fish], g }; F.ctx = { pond: 'river', dist: 0.5, bait: 'spinner', rod: FB.rodById.carbon, weather: 'sun', bubble: false }; F.target = { tx: 0.3, dist: 0.45 }; F.phase = 'bite'; F.window = 9; F.press(0, 0); }; return S.luck;
